description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueService interface which declares methods for managing CustomerOptionValue entities, including listing by store, saving or updating, and retrieval by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService to handle CustomerOptionValue entities with additional methods specific to customer option values management.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects for a specific store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing CustomerOptionValue entity, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue based on store and option value code.
